# Highlight

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("Highlight")`

An outline and a tint over a part or a model: what is selected, what can be picked up, an ally seen through a wall. **It is a mark on the picture, not a thing in the world**: it is drawn over the finished frame in the colours it was given, whatever the light, and nothing can collide with it or find it with a ray. At most `[render] max_highlights` are drawn in a frame (32 unless the project says otherwise); past that the nearest win.

**Members below are the ones this class DECLARES.** Everything its base
offers is on the base's page, which is what keeps one added member on
`Instance` from being a change to every page here.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Adornee` | `(BasePart | Model)?` | — | read/write | What is highlighted: a part, or a model and every part in it. Nothing means the highlight's own parent. |
| `DepthMode` | `Enum.HighlightDepthMode` | `Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop` | read/write | Whether the highlight shows through what is in front of the shape, or only where the shape itself is seen. |
| `Enabled` | `boolean` | `true` | read/write | Whether it is drawn. |
| `FillColor` | `Color3` | `Color3.new(1, 0.2, 0.2)` | read/write | The colour laid over the whole shape. |
| `FillTransparency` | `number` | `0.5` | read/write | How see-through the fill is: 0 hides what it covers, 1 leaves only the outline. |
| `OutlineColor` | `Color3` | `Color3.new(1, 1, 1)` | read/write | The colour of the line round the shape's edge. |
| `OutlineTransparency` | `number` | `0` | read/write | How see-through the outline is: 1 is a fill with no line. |
